purpose: Prioritize source synthesis while preserving full inventory and all existing source reviews; this is file-role routing, not new semantic review.

role_definitions.assessment_dependency: Collector, caller, registry, authentication, replay, CLI/MCP or renderer affects what is actually observed and reported. Trace it with its evaluator; missing data and mocked output are not compliance.
role_definitions.assessment_guidance: GHQR purpose, operation, reporting or manual-check limitations provide substantive assessment guidance; preserve observed capabilities separately from claimed completeness.
role_definitions.check_definition: Pinned GHQR rule definition, with source ID, target scope and severity; it must be reconciled with implementation, manual limitations and deliberate local policy selection.
role_definitions.context_reference: Source contribution practices, navigation or references retain their authored claims and context; reopen passages implicated by synthesis.
role_definitions.contract_fixture: Synthetic data generation supports test/demo interpretation; retain its limitations and do not count fabricated entities as live evidence.
role_definitions.contract_test: Retain source test as assessment-contract evidence linked to implementation; test presence is not proof that a local or native system satisfies the check.
role_definitions.evaluator_implementation: Actual assessment predicate or common evaluator finding/result logic; retain as substantive behavior evidence rather than excluding it as website code.
role_definitions.interpretation_dependency: Build dependencies or site include/config inputs support source interpretation; retain their existing claims without adopting the upstream toolchain as a universal requirement.
role_definitions.rights_metadata: License is retained as a rights input and source-internal tension where applicable; classification grants no redistribution clearance.
role_definitions.tool_infrastructure: Source distribution/build/install or site-branding support; reuse existing dispositions rather than repeating independent standards extraction without a concrete synthesis need.
